caption:
are your under-eye bags water or fat?

Take two photos today: one right after you wake up, one in the evening. Same light, same spot. Then one more pair: facing a window, and under a ceiling light.

Some people see a big difference between them. Some see none at all. Both answers mean something — Part 2 tomorrow.

One word: did your morning photo look puffier? Yes or no.

10-second mirror test from a doctor in Seoul. Follow so you see Part 2.

General education only.
